description: Additive h^max splits the operators into disjoint groups (a *partition*). For each group it computes `h_max` with only that group's operators at their real cost; all other operators cost 0. The sum over the groups is the estimate. Each operator's cost is counted in one group only, so the sum never overestimates the cost of a plan (it is *admissible*), and you can use it with A* for optimal plans. The crate's default puts each operator in the group of the lowest variable it changes; `with_partition` takes your own groups.

papers.authors: Patrik Haslum, Blai Bonet, Héctor Geffner
papers.title: New Admissible Heuristics for Domain-Independent Planning
